# Suchi Android WebView App

This is an Android application that displays the Suchi website (https://suchi-freshness-delivered-281434672237.us-west1.run.app/) in a WebView with native Android appearance.

## Features
- WebView integration without address bar or tabs
- Google Sign-In support
- Mobile number authentication
- Native Android look and feel
- Release APK generation without Android Studio
